payload.title: A CLI older than the site's backend must refuse to write (it wrote a Story version with no language)
payload.description: 2026-11-15, TheHallucinator.ai (backend on Papyrus 5.121.0, CLI pinned at 5.105.0): papyrus stories save-version wrote version 3 without its language fields. Publish then failed to project: 'has no language yet. The row was written before the language fields existed, or by a Papyrus older than 5.110.0'. The data was already marked published and the page stayed on the old version until a v4 was saved with the 5.121.0 CLI. Expected: every write command compares the CLI version with the site's deployed backend version and refuses to write when the CLI is older, naming the version to use (read-only commands may still run). Actual: the old CLI writes bad data and the failure appears later, at publish.
